dict.string: Super Flow uses Accessibility to put your spoken words into the text box you are typing in, to read a little text around the cursor for spelling and context, and to notice when a meeting app is running.
Super Flow sends Apple events only to paste text into another app or open a meeting link when you ask it to.
Super Flow needs your computer's audio to transcribe the other participants in your meetings. Audio never leaves this Mac.
Super Flow reads your calendar to name meetings, suggest who is speaking and remind you before a meeting starts. Nothing is written to your calendar.
Super Flow listens only while you dictate or record a meeting, and transcribes everything on this Mac.
Super Flow can use Apple's on-device speech recognition as an optional engine. Audio never leaves this Mac.
